dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Dogecoin’s main appeal is its low transaction fees and fast processing times. This makes it ideal for microtransactions, like tipping content creators or making small online purchases.
@cb_doge Unlike Bitcoin, which has a limited supply, Dogecoin has an unlimited supply, meaning new coins keep getting mined. This gives it an inflationary nature, with more coins added each year

@cb_doge Originally created for fun, Dogecoin quickly gained a passionate community. With no max supply, it’s used for tipping, small payments, and charity fundraising. Its popularity has surged, especially with endorsements from celebrities like Elon Musk.

@cb_doge Dogecoin is a cryptocurrency created in 2013 as a joke based on the popular 'Doge' meme featuring a Shiba Inu dog. Despite its fun origins, it’s become one of the most well-known cryptos due to its low transaction fees and fast processing times. #Dogecoin #Cryptocurrency
